title: Text requests work across more providers
summary:
A text API compatibility fix landed while the community catalog gained five apps for building and making images.

The text API now removes Anthropic-style `cache_control` annotations from message content parts before forwarding requests to Mistral, Kimi, Kimi K2.6, and GLM. That prevents those providers from rejecting requests from clients such as Claude Code via claude-code-router; other content is unchanged.

The app catalog added three community projects: Worl Tools, an offline-first desktop toolkit; App forge; and Pyanchor, a live-edit sidecar for Next.js, Vite, and Astro apps.

Photo Prompt joined the catalog with multi-model image generation and a prompt library, alongside ZenWall AI for minimalist vertical wallpapers. The README’s news and recent-app sections were also refreshed.
